lines.text: All Israel gathered at Shechem to make Rehoboam king, and Jeroboam returned from Egypt after hearing of it.
Israel asked Rehoboam to lighten the heavy yoke Solomon put on them, and he said to return in three days.
Rehoboam first consulted the priests who had served Solomon, who urged kind words, but he rejected their advice.
The young men advised adding to the yoke, and Rehoboam answered harshly, as God had spoken through Ahijah to Nathan.
Israel went home, the people stoned Hadoram to death, and Rehoboam escaped to Jerusalem in his chariot.
